scheme_name: Promotion of Science Education (POSE) Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Must have passed Class X and Class XII examinations with a minimum of 80% marks for Haryana Board schools or 85% for other boards (CBSE/ICSE etc.).
Must have taken admission in the first year of B.Sc./B.S./B.Stat./B.Math./Integrated M.Sc./M.S. programmes in basic and natural science subjects in India.
Only regular students are eligible; privately enrolled, correspondence/distance mode, or students in unrecognized institutions are not eligible.
The applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship.
For students who studied in schools outside Haryana, a Haryana Residence Certificate must be produced.
Preference will be given to female students, to the higher English/Hindi language score in Class 12, and to younger applicants (these are preferences, not mandatory criteria).

Students who completed 11th and 12th grades in non‑elite rural schools receive an additional 2% weightage in merit calculation; elite rural schools (fees exceeding Rs.1 lakh per year) are excluded from this extra weightage.
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship of ₹4,000 for years 1‑3 and ₹6,000 for years 4‑5, plus a one‑time mentorship grant up to ₹22,000, with up to 250 scholarships offered.
documents_required: Haryana Residence Certificate (if school studied outside Haryana)
Rural area school certificate of passing 11th and 12th classes, signed by the Principal and the Sarpanch/Gram Sachiv of the village panchayat
